scientific_integrity: The value Z=4 and general zero-forcing reconfiguration definitions are prior results; the proposed contribution is the complete five-family minimum-set classification and exact one-exchange graph. Arbitrary-circumference conclusions rest on an explicit proof; finite programs corroborate only tested sizes.
scientific_limitations: The 13n count, degree polynomial and 48n edge count hold for circumference n at least 6; the smaller circumference n=5 has a different degree profile. Distances, mixing, and other forcing variants are not determined. The finding does not assert independent publication priority.
title: Minimum zero-forcing sets and their exchange graph on circular ladders
